name: g_musicchannel
note: 0x00C6F08C -- the MUSIC channel, and it must be allocated here. PlayTrack only reaches its own AllocChannel in the ElseIf; when music volume is 0 it takes the `If a0 = 0 Or g_musicvol = 0` branch, which merely Stops the channel. TEngine.ResumeSounds then does ResumeChannel on this slot unconditionally, and BRL's ResumeChannel is a bare `channel.SetPaused False`. Named g_Object858 here until the split with g_musicchannel was closed; the two were one slot all along, so with music=0 the boot allocation landed on a Global no reader used and the first training crashed.
